newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Aeroflot offers $220 trial on int flights.
newsitem.headline: Aeroflot offers $220 trial on int flights.

text.p: Aeroflot-Russian International Airlines has introduced a promotional rate of $220 for all its international flights between June 16 and July 6, a senior company official said on Wednesday.
Andrei Zhebrak, head of Aeroflot tariffs department, told Reuters that the company began selling return tickets with the $220 rate to all destinations from Tuesday.
"We are launching an advertising campaign to attract passengers to our flights," Zhebrak said.
He said the $220 rate was not available for Aeroflot's domestic, CIS and Baltic states routes or the company's cargo flights.
Passengers who buy low rate ticket must stay at their destination a minimum six days and a maximum 30 days, he said, adding that such tickets could not be reserved.
"Passengers with low rate tickets cannot return the ticket or change the departure and arrival dates," Zhebrak said.

Aeroflot, which operates scheduled flights from Moscow to 94 countries around the world, launched a public relations campaign last year to try to brush up its poor Soviet-era image and draw passengers away from other international carriers.
